Root cause: `LRUCache.__getitem__` returned values without updating its `OrderedDict`, so reads did not affect eviction order.

final_text:
Root cause: `LRUCache.__getitem__` returned values without updating its `OrderedDict`, so reads did not affect eviction order.

Changed `LRUCache.__getitem__` to mark successfully retrieved keys as recently used, including reads via `cache.get()`. Missing items are safely excluded from the touch operation.
